## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T00:58Z

Read fresh. `ObjectView`'s `handleDeleteView` shows only "Delete failed" for any refusal. The server's sentence, including the new `409` remedy, reaches `console.error` alone. This was measured on the harness. It is #11583's family delete row, which was never carried.
- **`priority:p3`:** the refusal is visible and only its reason is missing. The save rows already use the description channel this needs.
- **Not a protocol follow-up**, and the `?package=` half is out of scope, as the card says: `DataSource.deleteView`'s published signature carries no package.
- **Lane `domain:ui`.** Scope: the card's acceptance, with one pin.
- `finding` leaves on grading.

Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` reads no path-derived mandate)

Responsibility: `objectui's ObjectView handleDeleteView, which drops the server's refusal sentence | the description channel objectui#11583 gave the view saves already exists | every console user whose view delete is refused (permission, sealed, or the 18.0.0-next.1 409 for a view two packages hold)`
Thread-read: 6181914119
Serial constraints cleared: none. In flight: objectui#12397 (`apps/console` `AppManagementPage.tsx`, `app-shell` `services/MetadataService.ts`), objectui#12402 (`app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts`, `metadata-client.ts`), objectui#12393 (PR #12408, `plugin-grid`), all disjoint from `ObjectView.tsx`.

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12414 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-15T03:11Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `b693066`, against the card's acceptance as triage confirmed it (`6181914119`) and the claim (`6182349010`), not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`. Its body opens `Fixes #12398`, the only closing keyword, followed by `Clause-②: no`. The governed sweep reads NOT governed, 45 lines (+37 / −8), 4 files, inside the claimed surface.
- **The acceptance, met:**
  - `handleDeleteView`'s refusal toast keeps its translated title and now carries `formatMetadataError(err)` as its description, with the `whitespace-pre-line` class;
  - it uses the same channel and helper #11583 gave the view saves; there is no second extraction and no text parsing;
  - no `?package=` is sent from `deleteView`, as ruled.
- **Pin and ablation:** the #11583 harness's old delete control is now a pin asserting the title key and the door's sentence in the description. Removing the description fails only that pin (`expected 'undefined' to contain 'held by two packages'`). Restore was proven by blob hash. The census row keeps its kind and pin; only its reason text is updated.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
- **Evidence:** the harness plus the census give 21/21 under the lock; the `ObjectView.*` and census files give 587/587. The closure build and type-check exit 0; the battery exits 0. The whole `src/views/` directory and the full app-shell project were NOT MEASURED locally (a 540 s timeout), as declared; CI's shards are read below.
- **Ruling on the card's 409 half (the seat's, under no-escalation scope):** `Fixes #12398` stays. The card's acceptance is the panel's channel, and it is met and pinned. The dev measured that when the PUBLISHED half of the adapter's `deleteView` is refused, the adapter throws its own "NOT fully removed … retry the delete" Error. The server's sentence and the 409 remedy then sit on `err.cause` only, so the toast shows the adapter's sentence. That is a producer fix in `data-objectstack`, and app-shell must not grow a `cause` reader: **filed #12416**.
- **Out-of-scope finding:** `handleRenameView` has the same silent refusal toast, the family's last view-write row: **filed #12417**.
- **CI at head:** 34 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`), all 12 test shards included.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
